text: Depression, otherwise known as major depressive disorder or clinical depression, is a common and serious mood disorder. Those who suffer from depression experience persistent feelings of sadness and hopelessness and lose interest in activities they once enjoyed. Aside from the emotional problems caused by depression, individuals can also present with a physical symptom such as chronic pain or digestive issues. Depressed individuals also present with irritability, brooding, and obsessive rumination, and report anxiety, phobias, excessive worry over physical health, and complain of pain.

Anxiety disorders are mental health disorders characterized by the presence of persistent and excessive worry, fear, anxiety and related behavioral disturbances such as hyperarousal, muscle tensions, hypervigilance and avoidant behaviors. These occur as a response to a real or a perceived threat, either in the present or in anticipation of future events/ threats. Anxiety disorder can cause the person to avoid an anxiety provoking situation or object and often interferes with functioning in day to day life activities and causes occupational and social impairment. There are different types of anxiety disorders such as Generalized Anxiety Disorder, Panic Disorder, Specific Phobia, Social Anxiety Disorder, Agoraphobia, Separation Anxiety Disorder and Selective Mutism.
